definitions.explanation: A state of being in a superior or advantageous position compared to others.

examples.japanese: {優位|ゆうい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
{価格面|かかくめん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{優位|ゆうい}な⟦{立場|たちば}→立場：03403_tachiba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: We are in an advantageous position in terms of price.

examples.japanese: {技術力|ぎじゅつりょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{優位|ゆうい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{維持|いじ}する→維持する：17311_ijisuru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{研究開発|けんきゅうかいはつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{投資|とうし}→投資：04711_toushi⟧し⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: We continue to invest in R&D to maintain our technological advantage.

notes:
{優位|ゆうい} describes a state of being in a superior or dominant position. It functions as both a noun and a な-adjective, and is especially common in business, strategy, and competitive contexts.

COMPOUNDS:
⟦{優|ゆう}→優：00431_yuu⟧ (superior) + ⟦{位|い}→〜位：00443_i⟧ (rank/position).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {優位|ゆうい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: to gain the upper hand
- {優位|ゆうい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧: to maintain superiority
- {優位|ゆうい}な⟦{立場|たちば}→立場：03403_tachiba⟧: advantageous position
- ⟦{競争|きょうそう}→競争：01388_kyousou⟧{優位|ゆうい}: competitive advantage
- {優位|ゆうい}{性|せい}: superiority, advantage (as a quality)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{有利|ゆうり}→有利：03651_yuuri⟧: advantageous, favorable (broader use, more everyday)
- ⟦{優勢|ゆうせい}→優勢：16328_yuusei⟧: superiority, dominance (often used for military or sports situations where one side is winning)
